project.purpose: Continuously discover and reproduce adversarial LLM/agent failure families, map them to owner-level root causes, and produce regression evidence without duplicating external red-team frameworks or production Security authority.

nodes.label: ThreatModelRef
nodes.responsibility: Bind attacker knowledge, access, adaptivity, state scope, success object and budget.

nodes.label: AttackProvider
nodes.responsibility: Generate attack candidates using provider-owned search algorithms.

nodes.label: TargetBinding
nodes.responsibility: Bind exact model/agent/monitor/system subject and configuration.

nodes.label: ObservationEvidence
nodes.responsibility: Retain trajectory and final-world-state digests without promoting observation to root-cause truth.

nodes.label: IndependentJudge
nodes.responsibility: Evaluate invariant violation independently of attacker search feedback.

nodes.label: FailureCluster
nodes.responsibility: Collapse many exploit instances into candidate vulnerability/root-cause families.

nodes.label: MinimumOwnerRepair
nodes.responsibility: Patch the smallest owner that can restore the violated invariant.

nodes.label: AdaptiveRetest
nodes.responsibility: Retest with a defense-aware attack set plus benign utility regression.

nodes.label: SecurityEvidenceBridge
nodes.responsibility: Project provider artifact identity onto the existing Security EvidenceRef mechanical waist without replacing S01-S05 authority or promoting study findings to standing.

nodes.label: AgentAttackSurfaces
nodes.responsibility: Exercise cross-session memory poisoning, runtime tool-trust drift, and monitor blind spots with synthetic canaries and deterministic judges.

nextSlices.objective: Add provider adapters for PyRIT and garak using immutable replay fixtures, without live third-party targets.
Add AgentDojo as the first stateful external-world provider and compare transcript judges with deterministic world-state judges.
Add model/monitor red-team targets only after subject identity, raw evidence retention, and budget accounting are proven by replay fixtures.
